newsitem.title: USA: Burlington renews Siemens U.S. deal.
newsitem.headline: Burlington renews Siemens U.S. deal.

text.p: Burlington Air Express said it has won a new four-year contract worth $6-million annual to provide Siemens with overnight air freight services throughout North America.
The pact covers all Siemens' U.S. divisions, with the highest percentage of traffic concentrated in Siemens' Business Communications and Healthcare products.

Burlington has been handling Siemens overnight air freight business since 1992. The express company said the new agreement covers North American overnight and second day air freight and some international express freight service.
